snippet.title: Times of Progress - First Playthrough
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam: store.steampowered.com/app/2628450/Times_of_Progress/
=====
Times of Progress is a City Builder set during the Industrial Revolution. Build industries to extract natural resources. Produce goods to satisfy the population. Manage transportation routes by train and ship. Expand on procedurally generated maps and trade with nearby cities.
